records.title: Chanel Cruise 21/22 Show Styling
records.creator: Leonie Hanne
records.setting: Hamburg waterside railing and pale urban buildings; location supported by creator article, exact shooting spot not independently identified.
records.visibleDescription: 粉色外套、浅色内搭和白裤，领口层叠长短珠链，白色小包；水面、石栏和浅色建筑形成背景。
records.editorialMatch: 粉色外套轮廓与层叠珠链，适合解释拿破仑风中剪裁和配饰的秩序；也可作为浅色优雅造型参考。
records.fitLimits: 不是视频同款；照片没有证明其属于Napoleon Core。Chanel服饰和配饰标注来自作者本人文章；摄影师未署名，不推定为作者自拍。
records.recommendedWebsiteUse: External creator/work reference card by default. Do not present the full original as an unrestricted downloadable library asset.
records.credit: Styling / source author: Leonie Hanne; photographer not named in the cited source.

records.title: FAUX FUR SCARF X THE ROW MARGAUX BAG
